cancelled.title: Verification cancelled
cancelled.message: You did not authorize the bot. Go back to Discord and press Verify again if you want to verify.

unavailable.title: Try again
unavailable.message: Verification is not available right now. Go back to Discord and press Verify again in a minute.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.message: This verification link is invalid, expired or already used. Go back to Discord and press Verify again.

notSetUp.title: Verification is not set up
notSetUp.message: Verification is not set up in this server. Ask a staff member.

wrongAccount.title: Wrong account
wrongAccount.message: You authorized with a different Discord account than the one that pressed Verify. Log in with the right account and try again.

held.title: Waiting for approval
held.message: Thanks. A staff member needs to approve your verification first. You will get a DM when it is done.

verified.title: You are verified
verified.message: Thanks. You can close this page and go back to Discord.

failed.title: Verification failed
failed.message: Something went wrong. Go back to Discord and press Verify again.
